thread:
Tori (AE): VerdantPay wants a 6-week POC. Requirement: EU-only processing for PHI, subprocessors list scoped to EU, BYOK w/ HSM preferred, and a simple line-item delta for a small reserved pool. Can ops/legal help scope?
Diego (SE): quick clarifying q: do they require the control plane to be in EU or is metadata-only control-plane (token exchange, routing) allowed outside EU?
Ben (VerdantPay): metadata control-plane outside EU is OK as long as no user content leaves EU. They also want regional failover policy that doesn't route data through non-EU regions.
Hannah (Legal): we can provide subprocessors inventory + SOC2/ISO docs. If they insist on EU-resident control plane we push to Private; that'll change timeline and pricing.
Omar (Infra): hosted = geo-affinity, not a guaranteed hard lock. Dedicated supports tenant pinning to eu-central-1 or eu-west-1; data-plane (inference, storage, KV) remains in-region. BYOK HSM provisioning ETA ~10 business days.
Diego (SE): sample endpoint we can show engineers: POST https://api.eu.redwood-inference/v1/generate (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Control plane: https://control.redwood-inference.com (global).
Tori (AE): Ben, ballpark extra cost for a small reserved pool (sustained ~50 QPS)? Need a headline to pass to procurement.
Diego (SE): ballpark: single-region small reserved pool ~ +$9k-12k/mo. Dual-region reserved or strict Private significantly higher. Quantization + batching can reduce effective token cost ~20%. Will follow up with a formal estimate.
Hannah (Legal): I'll assemble DPA + subprocessors CSV with region flags. If they want subprocessors with EU-only infra we will mark them and call out exceptions.
Omar (Infra): ops checklist for VerdantPay to supply:
```
- Preferred EU region to pin (eu-central-1 preferred)
- Expected sustained QPS and peak
- BYOK public key + KMS contact + rotation policy
- IP ranges to allowlist (if required)
- Required certs/attestations (SOC2/ISO/etc.)
- POC start date window
```
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance notice - eu-west-1 kernel update 2025-03-08 01:00-01:30 UTC; no data-plane downtime expected.
Ben (VerdantPay): thanks — procurement wants the subprocessors CSV + a one-pager with steps for BYOK/HSM and timeline. Can you send that?
Tori (AE): will package subprocessors file + ops checklist + Diego's ballpark and send to VerdantPay later today. Hannah/Omar will you drop docs here?
Hannah (Legal): yes sending subprocessors CSV + standard addendum by EOD.
Omar (Infra): I'll drop BYOK/HSM onboarding one-pager and a short runbook for in-region pinning.
Ben (VerdantPay): excellent, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Tori (AE): great — tagging for deal-room follow-up.
